header.title: AFT BLOCK C: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 5 FUNCTIONS / HYDRAULIC SYSTEM

notes: Five repeated vertical PVG32 function sections are visible. Common lower rails are explicitly labeled P, T, LS, LS_A, and LS_B; A and B are work-port headers per slice, not whole-block shared rails. Fine-print component/cartridge numbers inside modules are illegible at this resolution. Red revision annotations are visible, including pressure-setting changes around the two winch sections and EV-10.6/EV-10.7; exact wording/settings should be re-read at higher resolution (visible values appear to include 225/260 bar and 150/225 bar). Handwritten red door-pressure notes and small warning-triangle numbers are not fully reliable at this resolution. The title block prints file name SWS108-Hydraulic_System-rev10-AFT_blockC.

OPEN command (B): PVEO shifts the spool so pressure flows through the section to B; A is connected back through the spool toward return. The opposite-side pilot pressure operates the cross-piloted load-holding block to permit controlled return from the A side.

flow_scenarios: Neutral: printed as closed neutral; the main spool blocks A and B from the pressure/return paths. The LS/pilot branches remain connected through their limiter/shuttle network as drawn.

Command TO PORT (A): the ON/OFF actuator shifts the main spool so supply is directed to work port A and work port B is connected to return. The A-side load-sense branch is selected through the shuttle toward LSp; its limiter can vent the signal to the blue drain/return rail above its setting.

Command TO STBD (B): the actuator shifts the spool oppositely so supply is directed to work port B and work port A is connected to return. The B-side load-sense branch is selected through the shuttle toward LSp; its limiter can vent the signal to the blue drain/return rail above its setting.

LS limiting: either lower-right limiter opens from its associated sensing branch to the common blue drain/return rail when its threshold is exceeded; the drawing prints 240 at each cartridge, while the red revision instruction specifies increasing LSAs to 260 bar.

ON/OFF-section pressure limiting: the lower-left spring-loaded cartridge opens between its connected internal pressure/pilot passage and the blue return/pilot rail above the revised 225-bar setting; the exact protected passage is not fully identifiable from this crop.
